==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
The light of the moon is magical and can be collected to create beings. This entire dream takes place on the night of a full moon. There is a contest for being creation, an event called Moon Makers, but the rules and terms of the contest are long and tedious to read. I agree to the terms and find myself on a large winding staircase.

I notice a group of beautiful women walking into a door by the stairs. I follow the women and find myself inside a mansion. There I meet a skinny but busty woman with freckles, green eyes, short brown hair worn as a bowl cut, wearing a red striped white sweater and blue daisy dukes.

The woman tells me about an infamous demon that became an adventurer. Working alongside the woman, who agrees to be my teammate in the contest, we cast a spell using moonlight magic to create a heroic counterpart to the demon that possesses divine power instead of demonic power. Our creation is a humanoid sasquatch covered in orange fur and wears a denim blue jacket with the number six printed on the back in a large orange font, but I don't learn the significance of the number before I wake up.
